result.explanation: The payment provider recorded a PAID charge of 24900 KRW for payment pay_0901 [payments:pay_0901] and a PAID webhook was logged [server_logs:2026-10-13T12:00:41Z@/api/payments/webhook], but the order row remained failed [orders:ord_0901]; the confirm step returned 409 and skipped re‑checking the provider [server_logs:2026-10-13T12:00:44Z@/api/payments/confirm], so credits were never granted.
result.customer_reply: Hello, I can see your payment of 24900 KRW was received, but our system left the order marked as failed, so the credits weren’t added. I will correct the order status and grant your std30 credits shortly. No further action is needed from you.
result.fix_action: Re-check the payment provider for this payment id and mark the order paid, then grant credits (requires approval). Code fix: confirm must re-query the payment provider when the local status is failed; reconcile must include failed orders with a PAID webhook.

sql: SELECT o.order_id AS o__order_id, o.payment_id AS o__payment_id, o.email AS o__email, o.reward_key AS o__reward_key, o.amount AS o__amount, o.status AS o__status, o.credited AS o__credited, o.created_at AS o__created_at, o.updated_at AS o__updated_at, p.payment_id AS p__payment_id, p.amount AS p__amount, p.currency AS p__currency, p.status AS p__status, p.card_last4 AS p__card_last4, p.customer_email AS p__customer_email, p.created_at AS p__created_at, g.grant_id AS g__grant_id, g.email AS g__email, g.reward_key AS g__reward_key, g.credits AS g__credits, g.status AS g__status, g.order_id AS g__order_id, g.created_at AS g__created_at, l.ts AS l__ts, l.route AS l__route, l.order_id AS l__order_id, l.http_status AS l__http_status, l.message AS l__message, m.email_id AS m__email_id, m.to_address AS m__to_address, m.event AS m__event, m.ts AS m__ts, m.order_tag AS m__order_tag FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = o.payment_id LEFT JOIN grants g ON g.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN server_logs l ON l.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN mail_events m ON m.order_tag = o.order_id WHERE o.order_id = 'ord_0901'
